//! Writes the TLJP checkpoint fixture used by tl-desktop's ignored rpcd integration test.
//! Same seeding as TradeLayer-Rust's tests/rpc_server.rs (finalized_state), with whole-unit
//! amounts (1e8 atoms per unit) so the adapter's atoms-to-units reshaping is visible.
use std::collections::BTreeSet;
use tradelayer_core::joint::JointProtocolState;
use tradelayer_core::ledger::{AccountId, Ledger, Operation, PropertyId, PropertyKind, TxId};
use tradelayer_core::network_profile::TradeLayerMainnet;
use tradelayer_core::registry::Registry;
use tradelayer_core::spot::SpotExchange;

fn p(n: u32) -> PropertyId {
    PropertyId::try_from(n).unwrap()
}
fn a(s: &str) -> AccountId {
    AccountId::try_from(s).unwrap()
}
fn tx(n: u64) -> TxId {
    let mut b = [0_u8; 32];
    b[24..].copy_from_slice(&n.to_be_bytes());
    TxId::from_bytes(b)
}

fn main() {
    let out = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("output path");
    let mut ledger = Ledger::new();
    let ops = [
        Operation::CreateProperty { id: p(7), issuer: a("alice"), kind: PropertyKind::Fixed, initial_atoms: 100_000_000_000 },
        Operation::CreateProperty { id: p(9), issuer: a("bob"), kind: PropertyKind::Managed, initial_atoms: 500_000_000 },
        Operation::Transfer { id: p(7), from: a("alice"), to: a("carol"), amount_atoms: 25_000_000_000 },
        Operation::Transfer { id: p(9), from: a("bob"), to: a("carol"), amount_atoms: 150_000_000 },
    ];
    for (i, op) in ops.into_iter().enumerate() {
        ledger.apply(tx(i as u64 + 1), op).unwrap();
    }
    let permitted: BTreeSet<PropertyId> = [p(7), p(9)].into_iter().collect();
    let mut spot = SpotExchange::from_ledger_unverified(ledger, permitted).unwrap();
    spot.process_through_unverified(42).unwrap();
    let state = JointProtocolState::migrate_spot_components_unverified(
        TradeLayerMainnet::Litecoin,
        Registry::new(a("admin")),
        spot,
        42,
    )
    .unwrap();
    std::fs::write(&out, state.snapshot_bytes().unwrap()).unwrap();
}
